HEADER.TITLE: Limpicii Brasov Sports Club Association
HEADER.SUBTITLE: Through sports and hiking, we shape real people!
ACTIVITY_PAGES.TENNIS.INTRO: Tennis combines the joy of playing with the patience to improve, one step at a time. At Limpicii, children can also follow a path towards competitive performance.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.TENNIS.DESCRIPTION: Through technique exercises, rallies and matches, children build coordination, focus and confidence. Those who want to compete can follow training geared towards performance.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.TENNIS.LOCATION: At the Limpicii sports facility in Hălchiu, where the club has three tennis courts.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.TENNIS.COMPETITIONS: The club organizes a tennis tournament every September. Players can also take part in Romanian Tennis Federation competitions.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.TENNIS.CAMPS: Please contact the club for information about tennis camps.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.ATHLETICS.INTRO: Athletics runs as a separate performance program for children who want to train and improve their results.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.ATHLETICS.DESCRIPTION: Running, jumping and coordination exercises develop speed, endurance and discipline. Training is designed for athletes working towards steady progress.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.ATHLETICS.LOCATION: The training location is awaiting confirmation.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.ATHLETICS.COMPETITIONS: Participation in athletics competitions is awaiting confirmation.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.ATHLETICS.CAMPS: The athletics camp schedule is awaiting confirmation.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.SKIING.INTRO: Skiing brings outdoor movement, growing confidence and the joy of spending winter days together.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.SKIING.DESCRIPTION: On snow, children practice balance, coordination and control. The focus is on each child's progress and on the experience of learning together.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.SKIING.LOCATION: In Poiana Brașov, on slopes chosen for the group's level and the season's conditions.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.SKIING.COMPETITIONS: The club has organized the Limpicii Ski Cup. Future editions will be announced once the schedule is confirmed.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.SKIING.CAMPS: The club organizes a ski camp. Dates and details for each edition are shared with the season's schedule.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.GYMNASTICS.INTRO: Gymnastics gives children space to discover what their bodies can do, gain mobility and enjoy moving.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.GYMNASTICS.DESCRIPTION: Age-appropriate exercises support coordination, posture and flexibility. Every child can improve at their own pace through varied, accessible movement.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.GYMNASTICS.LOCATION: In the gym at the Limpicii headquarters, 1 Tablei Street, Brașov.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.GYMNASTICS.COMPETITIONS: The available information does not announce gymnastics competitions.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.GYMNASTICS.CAMPS: The available information does not announce camps dedicated to gymnastics.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.HIKING.INTRO: On the trail, children learn to move together, look out for one another and discover nature with curiosity.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.HIKING.DESCRIPTION: Hiking brings movement, navigation and shared experiences outdoors. Routes and pace are chosen for the group and the conditions of each trip.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.HIKING.LOCATION: In the mountains around Brașov and the surrounding area. Each route is chosen for the group and the weather conditions.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.HIKING.COMPETITIONS: Hikes are presented as group activities; no competitions are announced.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.HIKING.CAMPS: The club organizes seaside, Râmeț and mountain camps. Destinations change from year to year and may include the Bucegi Mountains or Moldoveanu Peak.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.SWIMMING.INTRO: Every step forward in the water matters. Swimming gives children confidence, coordination and the joy of moving together.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.SWIMMING.DESCRIPTION: The activity helps children become comfortable in the water and build endurance through movement. The focus is on personal progress and team spirit.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.SWIMMING.LOCATION: At the Olympic Swimming Pool in Brașov.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.SWIMMING.COMPETITIONS: Limpicii have taken part in the Brașov 24-hour swimming marathon. Future participation will be announced separately.
ACTIVITY_PAGES.SWIMMING.CAMPS: The available information does not announce camps dedicated to swimming.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_ONE: It all began in 1998, when a group of children prepared to take part in the 24-hour swimming marathon together. A playful blend of pici (‘little ones’) and olimpici (‘Olympians’) gave Limpicii their name.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_TWO: From the pool to the mountain trails, team spirit has remained at the heart of their story. In 2002, the group became a sports association, and its story continues with each new generation of children.
ABOUT.IMAGE_ALT: Limpicii club members together on a tennis court
ABOUT.CAPTION: Always a team.

FACILITY.COURTS_DESCRIPTION: Three tennis courts for practice and playing together.
FACILITY.LOCKER_ROOMS_DESCRIPTION: Two comfortable changing rooms for athletes.
FACILITY.SHOWERS_DESCRIPTION: Facilities to help athletes freshen up after practice.
FACILITY.GRANDSTAND_DESCRIPTION: A place for family and friends to cheer on the team.
HISTORY.TITLE: The History of the Club
HISTORY.IMAGE_ALT: An image representing the history of Limpicii Club
HISTORY.PARAGRAPH_ONE: In 1998, as we were preparing to take part as a team in the 24-hour swimming marathon, we began looking for a name that represented us. We were PICI (little ones), but not OLIMPICI (Olympians), so everyone thought LIMPICILOR was the best—and funniest—choice. Our mascot was always by our side and brought us good luck. Through our yearly participation in the swimming marathon, Limpicii stood out for their team spirit, which helped them push beyond their limits.
HISTORY.PARAGRAPH_TWO: The same golden rule brings us together on mountain trails, where a misstep can often be dangerous. From the Tisa to the Danube, the Limpicii have explored the Carpathians, rediscovering the beauty of Romania’s landscapes each time. From the youngest to the oldest, everyone takes part in the group’s activities: hiking, skiing, swimming, tennis, roller skating, dancing and fitness. Though they are different ages, the Limpicii are one big family. Each member has a well-defined role and responsibilities, helping carry the group’s tradition forward.
HISTORY.ASSOCIATION_INTRO: Founded in 2002, the Limpicii Brașov Sports Association organizes, runs and manages physical and sporting activities to support the physical and moral education of young people.
HISTORY.OBJECTIVES_INTRO: The association’s objectives follow the provisions of Physical Education and Sport Law No. 69/2000 and Government Decision No. 884/2001, which approves the regulation implementing that law. The association aims to improve and maintain its members’ health by:
HISTORY.OBJECTIVE_THREE: Including children with physical disabilities in all the activities we organize
HISTORY.OBJECTIVE_FOUR: Improving the facilities and equipment needed to run physical and sporting activities effectively and as safely as possible
HISTORY.OBJECTIVE_FIVE: Providing the human resources we need and training them in the spirit of teamwork
HISTORY.OBJECTIVE_SIX: Supporting and running educational and practical activities that promote recreational sports tourism, hiking to discover the beauty of nature, and environmental protection
HISTORY.OBJECTIVE_SEVEN: Developing and running our own programs and taking part in projects that support the association’s purpose
HISTORY.OBJECTIVE_EIGHT: Organizing and running any other activities that are compatible with the association’s purpose
HISTORY.PROGRAM: The sports program is set weekly. From Monday to Friday, group activities such as tennis and fitness are scheduled around the children’s school hours. On Saturdays and Sundays, the whole group takes part in activities such as trips, skiing and swimming. During school holidays, the regular program becomes more intensive and includes traditional camps: a winter ski camp, a seaside camp, a four- or five-day mountain trip, shorter two- or three-day trips, and cultural tour trips.
HISTORY.AFFILIATION: Since 2012, the Limpicii Brașov Sports Club Association has been affiliated with the Romanian Tennis Federation (FRT). Its athletes compete in FRT-sanctioned tournaments, and since 2015 the association has organized the Brașov Junior Tennis Championship, part of the FRT National Circuit, which brings together more than 100 children from across Romania each year.
